outputs: Chain-of-Thought reasoning outputs for question answering tasks

changes_made.explanation: Removed teacher models (ChatGPT) and evaluation model (GPT-4) from the models list since they are not the NLG models being evaluated/discussed. Consolidated duplicate dataset names and normalized to standard forms. Simplified outputs description to focus on core NLG task.
Normalized 'accuracy' to 'Accuracy' and removed 'GPT-4 Evaluation Score' which is not a traditional automatic metric but rather an LLM-as-judge evaluation method (covered in Q3).
Consolidated method descriptions into a single clear description. No specific evaluation criteria were mentioned in the paper for the GPT-4 evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only mentions automatic evaluation and LLM-based evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG evaluation through Chain-of-Thought generation and reasoning tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but included some teacher/evaluation models that were not the main NLG models being studied. The paper uses both traditional automatic metrics (Accuracy) and LLM-as-judge evaluation (GPT-4 scoring) but does not conduct human evaluation.
